CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_public_owner.human_resource_scope_v1(p_session uuid, p_encounter uuid, p_require_nonlesiva boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_sessions m
 join public.locations l on l.id=m.location_id
 join public.combat_v2_sessions cs on cs.master_session_id=m.id and cs.location_id=l.id
 join combat_panel_private.master_panel_sessions panel on panel.master_session_id=m.id and panel.location_id=l.id
 where m.id=p_session and cs.id=p_encounter and cs.state='in_corso'
 and m.owner_kind='human' and m.closed_at is null and m.suspended_at is null
 and exists(select 1 from mission_creation_owner.human_encounters he
 join public.mission_run_state run on run.master_session_id=he.master_session_id
 join combat_spatial.arena_instances arena on arena.master_session_id=m.id and arena.encounter_id=cs.id
 join combat_panel_private.master_scene_claims claim on claim.id=arena.panel_claim_id
 where he.master_session_id=m.id and he.encounter_id=cs.id
 and he.step_key=run.current_step_key and he.run_control_version=run.control_version
 and claim.master_session_id=m.id and claim.encounter_id=cs.id
 and claim.policy_id=panel.policy_id
 and claim.id=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(cs.id,'generic-arena-claim')
 and arena.instance_id=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(cs.id,'generic-arena-instance')
 and arena.context_source='panel_master' and arena.state='open')
 and ((l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and l.is_active and l.is_test
 and panel.policy_id='staff_test_no_persistent_resources_v1'
 and combat_panel_private.uses_simulated_pools(cs.id) and not public.combat_v2_values_written(cs.id)
 and (not p_require_nonlesiva or not cs.lesiva))
 or (mission_public_owner.human_session_allowed_v1(m.id)
 and panel.policy_id='master_game_resources_v1' and not combat_panel_private.uses_simulated_pools(cs.id)
 and public.combat_v2_values_written(cs.id) is not distinct from cs.lesiva)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_public_owner.human_session_allowed_v1(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from mission_public_owner.session_admissions_v1 a
 join mission_public_owner.release_admissions_v1 rel using(release_sha256)
 join mission_public_owner.publications_v2 pub on pub.request_key=a.publication_request
 join public.master_v2_sessions m on m.id=a.master_session_id
 join public.locations l on l.id=m.location_id
 join public.mission_run_state r on r.master_session_id=m.id
 join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=m.id
 join mission_generic_owner.definitions def on def.id=b.definition_id
 join mission_launch_owner.dual_decisions d on d.master_session_id=m.id
 join mission_launch_owner.dual_requests req on req.request_key=d.request_key
 join combat_panel_private.master_panel_sessions panel on panel.master_session_id=m.id
 where a.master_session_id=p_session and a.mode='human' and m.owner_kind='human'
 and m.master_user=d.actor_user and public.master_v2_is_master(m.master_user)
 and m.closed_at is null and m.suspended_at is null and m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso','chiusura')
 and m.mission_id=a.mission_id and m.location_id=a.location_id
 and l.is_active and not l.is_test and not l.is_exam_room
 and panel.location_id=l.id and panel.policy_id='master_game_resources_v1'
 and r.mission_id=a.mission_id and r.plan_version_id=a.plan_version_id and r.plan_sha256=a.plan_sha256
 and def.plan_version_id=a.plan_version_id and def.plan_sha256=a.plan_sha256
 and def.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(def.definition)
 and b.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(b.snapshot)
 and pub.target='public' and pub.state='open' and pub.visibility='open'
 and pub.mission_id=a.mission_id and pub.source_mission_id=a.mission_id
 and pub.release_revision_sha256=a.release_sha256 and pub.config_version=a.capability_version
 and d.activation_id=a.activation_id and d.request_key=a.start_request and d.mission_id=a.mission_id
 and d.mode=a.mode and d.plan_version_id=a.plan_version_id and d.plan_sha256=a.plan_sha256
 and d.roster_sha256=a.roster_sha256 and d.capability_version=a.capability_version
 and req.operation='start' and req.actor_user=d.actor_user
 and req.result->>'master_session_id'=m.id::text and req.result->>'mode'='human'
 and req.result->>'simulation'='false'
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources where carrier_mission_id=a.mission_id));
$function$
